facebook.caption: Tourists walk straight past this. Guan Di Temple on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo is one of Phu Quoc's oldest Chinese temples, and most visitors never find it. Red lanterns, incense smoke, carved wooden altars. Zero crowds. The kind of place that makes you stop scrolling and actually be somewhere. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Incense curling up past red lanterns. Nobody else here. Guan Di Temple is sitting right off Đường Trần Hưng Đạo and the tourist trail completely skips it. Don't be that person who only sees the resorts.
